{"id":"dbb3b2d6-860f-491d-9065-82cdcdccf08f","name":"Special Possibility Tokens","clearanceLevel":"ALPHA","publications":[],"text":"

The color and symbol below represent specific to a cosm. These are only earned during play in that cosm, but may be spent anywhere. Unlike standard , these are only granted for role-playing and choices that reinforces the specific world laws, or as a result of appropriate Cosm cards. Between acts, when you refresh , you may keep the same number of special (up to the maximum refresh) or reset them to standard .

\n"}
